description: This file defines the DisplayField entity class for the OrangeHRM project, mapping to the 'ohrm_display_field' database table. It includes properties like id, className, and a collection of selectedDisplayFields, along with getters and setters. The class extends AbstractDisplayField and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: DisplayField
classes.description: Entity class representing a display field, mapped to 'ohrm_display_field' table, with properties for id, className, and related selected display fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the display field.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with the display field.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name associated with the display field.
